personal_repos.name: amx-research
personal_repos.description: Microarchitecture research on Apple Silicon's shared AMX matrix unit: characterizing cross-process throughput contention as a timing channel (~1000 bps) and workload fingerprinting of co-resident ML inference. Threat model and mitigations included.

personal_repos.name: chrome.exposed
personal_repos.description: Free Chrome extension that shows, in plain English, what personal data each site shares with third parties. Read-only transparency: it watches and reports, it doesn't block.

personal_repos.name: amx-blind-fuzz
personal_repos.description: Blind operand-space fuzzing of Apple's AMX coprocessor: recover an undocumented integer instruction set from a cold start, with an int8 quantization analysis and a constant-time audit.

personal_repos.name: storetle
personal_repos.description: Pip-installable wheel for streaming large document corpora (USPTO, arXiv, PubMed, web crawls). HTML-aware compression with random access, about 46% smaller than gzip WARC.

personal_repos.name: neurit
personal_repos.description: A faithful-by-construction alternative to attention: every output carries a receipt of exactly which inputs caused it, and deleting any input marked irrelevant provably cannot change the output. A feasibility result on a memory task: faithful, but lower capacity than a transformer at this scale.

personal_repos.name: attn-research
personal_repos.description: A hardened testbed showing that a one-line change to attention (sparse/sparsemax) buys a provably faithful trace: point at exactly which tokens drove a decision, at no accuracy cost on a key-value recall task.

personal_repos.name: keystroke-auth
personal_repos.description: Keystroke dynamics behavioral biometric authentication demo

personal_repos.name: squarefree-percolation
personal_repos.description: Squarefree integers as quenched disorder preserve directed-percolation universality; the same disorder shuffled destroys it. Paper, two cross-validated engines, raw data, and blind-replication artifacts.

personal_repos.name: rsa-correctness-lean4
personal_repos.description: RSA correctness proved from first principles in pure Lean 4. 196 machine-checked lemmas, zero sorry, zero dependencies, no Mathlib.

personal_repos.name: situation-room
personal_repos.description: Real time OSINT visualization on a 3D globe

personal_repos.name: geohistory
personal_repos.description: Geography and history quiz game on a 3D globe

personal_repos.name: mixbox
personal_repos.description: Live TV, internet radio, and arcade games in one app
